ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Transporting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
